basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 110, a treasured corner condominium offering an unrivaled blend of stunning city views and convenience in iconic Telegraph Hill. A rare floorplan, this home boasts an elongated southern wall of oversized windows, allowing for remarkable entertaining with enhanced city outlooks and radiant sunsets. The spacious bedroom suite offers plenty of closet space and a walk-out balcony. Deeded, independent garage parking and storage complete this home, alongside two shared entertaining decks with panoramic views of the Bay Bridge and skyline, barbeque, community room with Peloton, and guest parking with EV charging. Your very own trophy urban retreat awaits, just steps from vibrant Jackson Square and North Beach!
